cells.name: SAME OWNER, REFRESH
cells.assertion: A same-owner remount returns all four previously set pin values, not defaults.

cells.name: SAME OWNER, EXIT AND RE-ENTER A SESSION
cells.assertion: A same-owner session exit and re-entry returns all four previously set pin values.

cells.name: SAME OWNER, NEW SESSION
cells.assertion: A newly created session under the same owner starts with the owner's pinned values.

cells.name: OWNER ISOLATION
cells.assertion: Owner B sees defaults and never Owner A's values; switching back to Owner A restores Owner A's values.

cells.name: UNRESOLVED OWNER AT BOOT
cells.assertion: No-owner boot reads defaults without writing unscoped keys, then sees scoped values once the owner resolves.

cells.name: FAILED OR EMPTY READ IS NOT AUTHORITATIVE
cells.assertion: A failed or empty read does not overwrite stored owner-scoped pins with defaults.

cells.name: UNKNOWN-KEY PRESERVATION
cells.assertion: An unrecognised preference key survives a known-pin-key write round trip.

cells.name: SCHEMA VERSION PRESENT
cells.assertion: The schema version key is written as a positive integer.

cells.name: PER-KEY WRITES, NOT A BLOB
cells.assertion: Writing one pin key does not rewrite the other three, and a concurrent writer on another key is not lost.

cells.name: BOUNDED SIZE
cells.assertion: An absurdly large pin list is rejected or clamped instead of being stored as-is.

cells.name: KILL-SWITCH OFF PATH
cells.assertion: With the owner-scoped pin kill-switch enabled, pin persistence and schema-version writes stay off.

cells.name: RESET PATH
cells.assertion: talPrefReset=1 clears all pin keys without requiring the chart to be loaded.
